description: Update a portal page's HTML or name. Can also make it the default page. Before changing the HTML always get_portal_page and pass checksum + site_id from SURFACE CONTEXT. IMPORTANT: if the page holds forms or tables with data, better use generate_ai_site, not this tool directly. If you do insert an iframe by hand, the only right format is: src='https://quintadb.com/widgets/APP_ID/ENTITY_ID?iframe=true'. APP_ID and ENTITY_ID come from describe_project. Do NOT invent other URLs.

embed_form.description: The MAIN way to PUT A FORM ON THE SITE («add a request form to the page», «so that a visitor leaves their contacts»). The server itself inserts a ready block with the form into the html and does NOT rewrite the rest — quinta-* blocks physically cannot be harmed. Do NOT pass html and page_checksum together with embed_form. If the form is already there, the answer says already_embedded and duplicates NOTHING.

anchor_text.description: Visible text on the page AFTER whose section the form is put (e.g. the heading «Lead funnel»). Not found or not passed — the form goes to the end of the page, and the answer says so plainly.

entity_id.description: ID of the form/table being embedded (list_forms)

heading.description: Heading above the form for the visitor

subtext.description: A line of explanation under the heading

html.description: New HTML content of the page

must_contain.description: A targeted edit (e.g. a site menu item): lines that MUST be in the saved HTML (the link's name, href). An independent verify check — if they are missing, the edit counts as failed.

nav_append.description: The MAIN way to add an item to the SITE MENU: the server itself inserts <a> into the page's <nav> and does NOT touch the rest of the html (quinta-* blocks are guaranteed whole). Do NOT pass html and page_checksum together with nav_append. If page_id is not known, it can be left empty — the site's home page is taken.

page_checksum.description: SHA256 of the current HTML from get_portal_page.checksum. REQUIRED when updating html — a call without checksum is refused.

set_as_default.description: Make this page the home page

site_id.description: site_id from SURFACE CONTEXT — dual-write into the right Site.

name: update_portal_page
